subject: Dispatch server down - can't load loads

resolution_notes: 22:14 PagerLine page, on-call (Andre Mitchell) acknowledged. 22:21 called BFL night dispatcher back, confirmed nobody can reach the dispatch (TMS) application on BFL-APP01. Set P1, began RB-SRV-002. Server not answering RDP; out-of-band console showed it stuck at a Windows update install screen. Waited 10 min with no progress, then rebooted per RB-SRV-002. subject: Nobody at the firm is getting email
description: No email is coming in for anyone at the firm since about 12:45. Outgoing messages are sitting in Outboxes too. We have a filing deadline this afternoon and clients are trying to send documents. Victor wants to know what's going on.
resolution_notes: 13:46 called Corinne back, confirmed firm-wide: inbound and outbound mail queued for all users since ~12:45. Set P1. Message trace showed messages pending/deferred on the Microsoft side; no changes on our side (connectors, transport rules, DNS/MX all unchanged). M365 Service Health posted an Exchange Online mail flow incident affecting some tenants in the region at 14:05. Updated Victor (managing partner) every 30 min by phone and set up a temporary workaround for the filing (documents sent via SharePoint link). Microsoft applied a fix; queued mail began delivering 16:40. Verified inbound/outbound with Corinne and spot-checked 3 mailboxes at 17:15. Cause: Microsoft-side Exchange Online incident. No action needed by client.

Confirmed WAN1 (fiber) down on EMS-FW01; ISP reports fiber cut near the site at ~05:35. Secondary circuit up but failover was not passing traffic. 06:24 Called Tom Kessler for help; Tom went onsite (arrived 06:58). 07:18 Tom found wan2 still set to static IP/gateway from the old cable modem (ISP swapped modem in July, Larkspur not told); changed wan2 to DHCP per RB-NET-004. 07:21 site traffic restored over the secondary WAN. Users notified via EMS ops manager. Shop floor and office (~60 users) affected 05:35-07:21. 07:30 handed to business-hours queue, Tom Kessler owner. 12:04 ISP completed fiber splice; primary WAN restored and traffic failed back to wan1. Verified Beacon agents reporting, VoIP registered, ERP reachable. 13:00 confirmed with EMS facilities manager. Follow-up: SD-WAN health-check alerting to be added in Beacon; post-mortem 2026-09-03; RCA to client.
